text:
Open it, and you know exactly what's on now.
And how long until it ends — to the second.

Your whole day, at a glance.
Every class. Every room. Every teacher.
Even the breaks in between.

Switch to the week, and it's all decoded.
Your classes, your busiest day, and every gap.

When your schedule changes, you'll know first.
Even when the app is closed.
And see which groups share the room with you.

Fourteen universities.
For students, and for teachers.
One app.

No signal? Your schedule is still right here.
In dark, or in light.

And your whole campus is right here.
Share what's happening. Reply. Make friends.
And capture moments that last a day.

Tap the clock five times.
Take a seat.

[Para](/pˈɑɹə/).
Everything that matters — right on time.
